notes: The input holds two arguments: old and new. Each one is the text of one family.yaml.
To replay a vector: parse each text with parse_family, then call classify(old, new).
value.changes holds each change in order. The other keys of value are what the Diff answers: changed, refused (the fields), needs_switch, switch_mode, steps and reason.
Each text has the shape of a family file. A text can break a value rule: classify reads a parsed file, not a valid one.
